Definition: ultimately from G4228; a shackle for the feet:--fetter.
BiblicalUsage: A pede is a fetter, a shackle for the feet. The demon-possessed man of the Gadarenes was often bound with fetters and chains, and he broke the bands and snapped the fetters in pieces, and no man could tame him.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure that no chain made by men can hold what only Christ can loose, and the man who broke every fetter was freed by a word from Jesus.
